children: Michael Brous as chief financial officer, effective September 28, 2026.
Brous will succeed Erin Brewer, who plans to retire. Brewer will remain with Lyft as an advisor through December 15 to support the leadership transition.
Brous has been part of Lyft’s senior management team for nearly eight years and currently serves as head of Lyft Urban Solutions and Safety and Customer Care.
Separately, Lyft reaffirmed its third-quarter guidance, calling for gross bookings of $5.5B to $5.67B, adjusted EBITDA of $183M to $203M, and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 3.3% to 3.6%.
The firm expects to report its third quarter 2026 earnings in November 2026.

title: Lyft names Michael Brous as CFO
